units: meters, seconds, Y up, +Z actor forward; anatomical left is +X
scope: Candidate game-motion kit. Source takes preserved; derived in-place loops and one-shots. C08 and B-REK43 only. Runtime transitions, contact IK, collision controller and props require visual acceptance.
motion_root: in-place; controller owns horizontal displacement and airborne jump arc

responsive_controls.cancel: latest explicit action wins; fresh movement cancels evade/attack
responsive_controls.traversal: explicit tags, range/facing/height and free destination; authored collision-checked path; exact contact IK remains open

hero_landing.pose: right knee / left fist down; right elbow up

contact_actions.method: Authored contact poses over existing generated sources, not new Kimodo inference
contact_actions.recording: Save take bakes these layers; original source clips and 94-clip packs do not.

variation.policy: state-entry shuffle bag; no immediate repeat; current take fixed; compared bodies share seed
variation.rejected: Current Game Kit Reject reviews and automatic_eligible=false excluded from automatic play; preferred mode falls back to eligible takes
variation.preview_export: Explicit selected/preferred takes; no random export selection

modifier_controls.focus: Game canvas only; not form controls or modals
modifier_controls.forward: Ctrl+W: happy skipping, 2.2m/s, dedicated generated loop
modifier_controls.keyboard_capture: Capture keys: JS fullscreen plus keyboard lock; Escape releases; browser permission required
modifier_controls.backward: Ctrl+S: 1.25m/s backward walk, camera heading held
modifier_controls.plain_s: Turn toward viewer and run back at3.8m/s; Shift sprints; stance/carry limits retained
modifier_controls.strafe: Ctrl+A/D: 1.25m/s lateral walk, camera heading held
modifier_controls.browser: All Ctrl chords prevent defaults in the viewport; unassigned chords reserved; Ctrl+W and other reserved browser shortcuts require Capture keys; form/modal editing and Meta shortcuts pass through

side_ukemi.low_obstacle: Plant impacting foot, compress hip/knee and continue incoming momentum over beam with matching-side roll; ground-level root and pose contacts
side_ukemi.high_obstacle: Same planted response; select away-side pool and collision-checked ground-level route

contact.method: World-space sole anchor and two-bone leg IK; authored pelvis tilt/twist and compression; source-specific entry timing bypasses idle preparation; after release torso-skin/leg contacts support low-beam crossing while all other obstacles block

side_ukemi.method: Existing six Kimodo sources plus kinematic contact constraints; not a full rigid-body/force simulation
side_ukemi.recording: Save take bakes selected source, planted leg solve, controller path and transitions; original source clips retain their generated motion

breakfalls.trigger: grounded standing locomotion contacts a low solid; frontal/backward by velocity versus facing; clear rollout required

loop_policy: Phase-searched interior window plus overlap crossfade. Position/quaternion endpoints match. Review velocity, contacts and balance separately.
jump_policy: Anticipation / airborne / landing source windows; controller supplies jump height and airtime. Jump source airborne root arc removed in game clip to avoid double height.
runtime_not_in_default_pack: Authored ledge and superhero pose layers
recording: Save take exports sampled actor transforms and bone poses including live IK. Prop mesh/trajectory are excluded.
